name: abcpreview-abcjs-build
description: Bundles abcjs as an ES module for ABC Preview. Run: npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm run build

scripts.build: esbuild node_modules/abcjs/index.js --bundle --format=esm --legal-comments=inline --banner:js="// abcjs 6.7.2 (MIT, see LICENSE.md), bundled as an ES module by tools/abcjs." --outfile=../../web/vendor/abcjs.mjs && cp node_modules/abcjs/abcjs-audio.css node_modules/abcjs/LICENSE.md ../../web/vendor/
